_comment: Semaphore v4 trusted-setup artifacts used to generate real B3 proofs. URLs are exactly those @zk-kit/artifacts 2.0.1 resolves for @semaphore-protocol/proof 4.14.2 (maybeGetSnarkArtifacts(Project.SEMAPHORE, {parameters: [depth], version: '4.13.0'})). Files are downloaded into .artifacts/ (gitignored) and refused unless their sha256 matches. On-chain verification uses B3's vendored SemaphoreVerifier.sol, whose verification key must agree with these artifacts (a mismatch makes the on-chain verification fail, which the live tests would catch).
